the-squirrels-note.where: Late afternoon light falls on Thalbern's stone and timber cottage at the edge of the woods. A red squirrel waits on the doorstep.

the-woodpile-wolf.where: Late afternoon light falls on Thalbern's cottage at the edge of the woods. A thin grey wolf has come out of the trees toward his gear.

broken-silence.where: Thalbern walks a deer trail through the Valkarr woods at night toward the Old Standing Stones.

the-owlbear-prowls.where: Thalbern hides in cover beside the deer trail as an owlbear comes out of the tree line onto the trail ahead, unaware of him.

owlbear-confrontation.where: An owlbear faces Thalbern across a small moonlit clearing on the deer trail.

timely-rescue.where: Thalbern lies wounded by the great oak beside the trail as Wollandora steps out of the trees.

meeting-at-the-stones.where: Moonlight fills the clearing where a line of ancient standing stones runs beside the river.

preparing-for-the-city.where: Morning sun falls on Thalbern's stone and timber cottage at the edge of the woods.

back-home.where: Morning sun falls on Thalbern's stone and timber cottage at the edge of the woods.
